title: Yo'l harajati normaga qo'shiladimi?
caption: ❓ Savol: «Yetkazish narxi ham 200 $ normaga qo'shiladimi?» Tovar 200 $ gacha bo'lsa — yo'q. Norma faqat tovar narxi bo'yicha tekshiriladi. Tovar 200 $ dan oshsa — BKO rasmiylashtiriladi va bojxona qiymatiga yo'l harajati ham qo'shiladi. 🧮 Ikki misol (kuryer, 2 kg, yo'l 19 $) • Kurtka 185 $ → norma ichida, yo'l hisobga olinmaydi, boj yo'q ✅ • Kurtka 215 $ → normadan oshdi ❌ Bojxona qiymati: 215 + 19 = 234 $ Boj: (234 − 200) × 30 % = 10,20 $ ≈ 121 359 so'm 1 ta BKO uchun yig'im — 110 000 so'm Jami: 231 359 so'm 💡 Qoida: tovarlar 200 $ dan oshmasin — shunda yo'l harajati ham, boj ham, yig'im ham yo'q. ✏️ Tuzatish: 7-oktabr va 10-oktabr obrazlarida yo'l harajati normaga qo'shib hisoblangan edi — bu xato. Ikkalasida ham tovarlar 200 $ dan arzon: boj ham, yig'im ham yo'q. 📄 Asos: VM 244-son; PQ-4508, 3-band; VM 55-son — lex.uz 📲 Normangizni ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #savol
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#savol".
2) Center: two cardboard parcels with price tags: the left tag reads 185 $ next to a green check mark and a crossed-out small delivery-truck tag; the right tag reads 215 $ with a delivery-truck tag attached and a small receipt, beside a thin indigo line marked 200 $. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of sky blue (#38BDF8); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Yo'l harajati normaga qo'shiladimi?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "200 $ gacha — faqat tovar narxi"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Muallif qoidasi (11.10.2026): tovar 200 $ gacha — boj yo'q, yo'l qo'shilmaydi; oshsa — BKO, bojxona qiymati = tovar + yo'l. Minimal 3 $/kg qo'llanmadi. Yo'l: 2.0 kg × 9,50 $ = 19.0 $. Hisob: (215.0 + 19.0 − 200) × 30 % = 10.2 $.
